external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app, signs in, views or edits invoices, and requests PDFs.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and accesses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who works from the support office network and uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, which authenticates users, handles invoices and payment pages, queues PDF jobs, and accesses shared stores.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to authenticate and open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared cloud bucket where the PDF renderer stores PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A customer user signs in to the billing app with an email address and password and receives a session cookie.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie; second factor: none
data_flows.data_description: email address, password, and session cookie

data_flows.name: open invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user opens an invoice in the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.

data_flows.name: edit invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user submits the whole invoice form to the billing app for saving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back
data_flows.data_description: whole invoice, including paid flag and payout bank account

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: A customer user requests a PDF of an invoice from the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.description: The payer follows the invoice link to access the payment page, which requires no sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: read and write records
data_flows.description: The billing app queries and saves invoice and customer records in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: invoices, customers, payout bank details, and user activity

data_flows.name: put render job
data_flows.description: The billing app puts a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.

data_flows.name: take render jobs
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads the invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes the rendered PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket using one shared service credential.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console with an account and one-time code.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code

data_flows.name: open session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user on behalf of a support agent.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant or customer-company boundary containing a customer user's company context.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform hosting the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database is confidential because it contains invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket is confidential because it stores PDFs rendered from invoices and associated company identifiers.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the PDF renderer writes invoice PDFs to the bucket under a company ID and invoice number.
